    sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    edges = []
    for i in range(1, n):

        adj[v].append((u, i))
        edges.append((u, v))

    depth = [0]*(n+1)
    size = [0]*(n+1)
    heavy = [-1]*(n+1)

        max_size = 0
        for v, idx in adj[u]:
            if v != parent[u]:
                parent[v] = u
                depth[v] = depth[u] + 1
                dfs(v)
                size[u] += size[v]
                if size[v] > max_size:
                    max_size = size[v]
                    heavy[u] = v

    dfs(1)

    pos = [0]*(n+1)
    current_pos = 1

        nonlocal current_pos
        head[u] = h
        pos[u] = current_pos
        current_pos += 1
        if heavy[u] != -1:
            decompose(heavy[u], h)
        for v, idx in adj[u]:

                decompose(v, v)

        while head[u] != head[v]:
            if depth[head[u]] > depth[head[v]]:
                u = parent[head[u]]
            else:
                v = parent[head[v]]
        return u if depth[u] < depth[v] else v

    edge_to_day = [0]*(n)
    day_to_edges = {}

            days.append([i+1])
            day_to_edges[len(days)] = [i+1]

            found = False

                if ancestor in [pos[x] for x in day_to_edges[d]]:

                    day_to_edges[d].append(i+1)
                    found = True

                day_to_edges[len(days)] = [i+1]
